purpose: Test whether pass\n is idempotent in the null-witness monoid: u=pass, u^2=pass;pass, u^3=pass;pass;pass. Pre-registered: (1) nontriviality LCB D(epsilon,u) > eps_sep, (2) first stability UCB D(u,u^2) < eps_eq, (3) power stability UCB D(u^2,u^3) < eps_eq. Codex design: d4 only, 48 new calls (u^2 and u^3 only; epsilon and u come from Gate 1b).

predictions.H_idempotent: If pass is idempotent (P^2=P): TV(pass,pass^2) < eps_eq AND TV(pass^2,pass^3) < eps_eq. Both stability conditions must hold.
predictions.H_transient_plateau: Like newline: TV(pass,pass^2) small but TV(pass^2,pass^3) large. Transient plateau, not stable monoid relation.
predictions.H_accumulating: TV(pass,pass^2) and TV(pass^2,pass^3) both large. Pass effect accumulates, no saturation.
predictions.decisive_comparison: Power stability: TV(pass^2,pass^3). If < 0.01: idempotent candidate. If > 0.02: refuted.

estimated_calls: 2 roles x 1 surface x 3 vars x 8 vals x 1 depth = 48 calls, ~30s on CPU
